title: observability-token-kv-cost-latency-dashboard-alert-tuning
author: Ethan Park
description: Motivation: production customers and SRE have asked for finer-grained visibility into token-level KV cache behavior and the resulting cost/latency tradeoffs. This PR adds Prometheus metrics for per-token KV cache hits/misses, token-level per-request latency and per-token cost tagging, Grafana dashboards for slice-and-dice analysis, and alert tuning to reduce noise while preserving SLO guardrails. Summary of changes: three main commits: 1) add token-level metrics and tracing hooks (observability/metrics/token_cost_metrics.go, observability/tracing/token_kv_span_extractor.go), 2) introduce Grafana dashboards (grafana/dashboards/token_kv_cost_latency_overview.json and token_kv_cache_heatmap.json) with template variables for model, region, and deployment tier, 3) alert tuning and terraform changes to update thresholds and silences (terraform/monitoring/alerts.tf, pkg/alerts/kv_alerts.go). Also updated docs and tests (docs/observability/token_metrics.md, tests/integration/token_metrics_test.go). Checklist: - [x] Metrics instrumented with labels for model, deployment, and request_type - [x] Traces emit token-level spans to link KV hits to latency - [x] Dashboards built with sensible defaults and drilldowns - [x] Alerts thresholds adjusted based on 30d baseline and added runbook links - [x] Integration tests added and CI green Notes on alert tuning: tuned the KV-cache-miss-rate alert to avoid noisy pages observed during rollout spikes by moving from a 1m trigger to a 5m sustained threshold and adding a percentage-based suppression for high-throughput batch windows. Also added a separate signal for per-token-cost increases to protect against sudden billing regressions. Review highlights: Maya requested clearer labels on the Grafana panels and a brief guide in docs — addressed in commit 2 and docs updated. Lucas found a potential race in metrics registration during server startup; fixed by moving registration into pkg/observability/register_metrics.go and added an idempotent guard. Janelle asked to relax one alert condition for dedicated capacity customers; added an opt-out label and updated terraform accordingly. CI: initial integration job flaky on metrics test (timing-sensitive), re-ran a single flaky test with a small sleep stabilization and it passed. All checks green at merge. Release notes: "Added token-level KV cache and cost/latency metrics, Grafana dashboards for token-level inspection, and tuned alerts to reduce noise while protecting SLOs. Deployment: rolled to staging for 48h and then rolled to prod with a canary; no regressions observed." Commits summary: "3 commits: instrument token metrics and tracing; add dashboards and template variables; tune alerts and update docs/tests." Merge outcome: squashed and merged to main after approvals from all reviewers, closing ENG-3421 and SUP-1287.
release_notes: - Added token-level KV cache and cost/latency metrics and tracing hooks.- Introduced Grafana dashboards for token-level investigation (overview + heatmap).- Tuned alerts: increased window for KV-miss-rate, added per-token-cost alert and opt-out label for Dedicated.- Updated docs and integration tests.
additional_context: Deployed to staging (us-west-2) for 48h canary, then progressive rollout to prod. No increased error rates or latency regressions in the canary window. Metrics show 12% KV hit rate improvement after cache warming suggestions from Redwood Optimize.
